goal: Map where personal data is collected, stored, shared and deleted in the code, with the purpose and retention…
use: Map where personal data is collected, stored, shared and deleted in the code, with the purpose and retention of each. Use when a feature touches personal data.

steps.note: Find the personal data. List fields that hold personal data: names, emails, addresses, identifiers and location.
Map the flow. For each field, follow where it is collected, stored, sent to other services and logged.
Check the purpose. Each field should have a stated purpose.
Check retention. Each field needs a retention period and a delete path.
Check sharing. Flag personal data sent to third parties, or to a region the policy does not allow.
Report. A table: field, where collected, stored, shared, purpose, retention, and gaps.

protocol.title: Find the personal data
protocol.text: List fields that hold personal data: names, emails, addresses, identifiers and location.

protocol.title: Map the flow
protocol.text: For each field, follow where it is collected, stored, sent to other services and logged.

protocol.title: Check the purpose
protocol.text: Each field should have a stated purpose. Flag fields collected with no use.

protocol.title: Check retention
protocol.text: Each field needs a retention period and a delete path. Flag data kept with no delete.

protocol.title: Check sharing
protocol.text: Flag personal data sent to third parties, or to a region the policy does not allow.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: A table: field, where collected, stored, shared, purpose, retention, and gaps. This is a map for a person to review, not a legal opinion.
